stories.story: Bea said, “I want to give Grandpa Len a cup.” The cup's handle was wide because Grandpa Len's hand was stiff. The shaping rib slipped, and the cup was dented. Mr Ivo said, “The cup's wall is thick.” Bea said, “I want to smooth the dent.” Bea used the sponge to smooth the dent. Mr Ivo fired the cup twice. The cup was cool. Bea gave Grandpa Len the cup. Grandpa Len poured tea into the cup. Grandpa Len held the cup's wide handle.
